title: Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web
hook_before: Meta just paused its Muse AI sharing feature.
script:
Meta Muse is the tool sharing your chats.
This tool lets you share your AI conversations with others.
Researchers at the firm Claroc found links to these chats on the web.
They discovered more than 6,800 Muse links through public DNS records.
These links made private conversations publicly searchable.
Meta disabled the sharing function while they investigate the privacy flaw.
Would you share your AI chats if they could go public?
